name: X Social Momentum Scanner v7.1 - FIXED Google Sheets

parameters.content:
# X Social Momentum Scanner v7 - LLM Sentiment + Long/Short + Slippage

## What's new in v7 (vs v6)
- **Gemini 2.5 Flash sentiment gate** between scoring and paper trading.
  Only top-scoring tradeable candidates (max 15/run) are sent to LLM.
  Cost: ~$0.50/month or less.
- **Long AND short paper trading** based on LLM verdict.
- **Slippage model** applied at entry and exit: 0.3% (>$10B), 0.5% ($1B-$10B),
  1% ($300M-$1B), 2% (<$300M).
- **HTB risk flag** logged for shorts on stocks under $2B cap or with
  squeeze chatter, so you can filter the leaderboard later.
- **5th Sheets tab**: `llm_verdicts` logs every Gemini call (sentiment,
  confidence, reasoning, sarcasm flag, mentions-selling flag) so you can
  audit the LLM's accuracy.

## Required env vars
- `GETXAPI_KEY`     - https://www.getxapi.com/signup
- `FMP_API_KEY`     - your existing FMP key
- `GEMINI_API_KEY`  - https://aistudio.google.com/apikey (free tier exists)

## Required Google Sheets setup
Create ONE Google Sheet with FIVE tabs (exact names):
1. `candidates`     - every ranked candidate every run (now includes LLM verdict columns)
2. `paper_trades`   - OPEN and CLOSE events (now includes side, slippageBps, borrowRiskFlag)
3. `analyst_alpha`  - per-handle leaderboard (now includes long/short counts)
4. `portfolio`      - equity curve (now includes longCount, shortCount, blockedByLLM)
5. `llm_verdicts`   - every Gemini call's output for audit

## Trade decision logic (v7)
For each top-scoring candidate, LLM returns sentiment + confidence + flags.

- LONG opens if: sentiment=bullish, confidence>=0.6, NO sarcasm, NO mentions-selling,
  zero pump flags, change% < noChasePct.
- SHORT opens if: sentiment=bearish, confidence>=0.6, marketCap>=$500M (HTB safety),
  price>=$5 (regulatory), change% > -10% (still has room to fall).
- All other cases: block, log reason in 'blocked' diagnostics.

## Important caveats on the short paper P&L
The engine models slippage but NOT borrow fees, buy-ins, or upticks. Real shorts
can cost 10-100%+ annualized on HTB names. Use `borrowRiskFlag` on closed
short trades to filter the analyst alpha leaderboard - any handle whose short
alpha comes mostly from HTB-flagged trades is unlikely to be replicable live.

## After 8-12 weeks
Open `analyst_alpha`. Need at least 30 trades per handle to draw conclusions.
Keep handles with avgPctReturn > 0 after slippage. Drop the rest.
Compare long-only vs short-only performance via `paper_trades.side` filter.

## DO NOT auto-trade real money from this.

# v7.1 fixes

- Fixed FMP Stock News node reference.
- Added gate before GetXAPI so off-hours/empty runs do not call X.
- Added gate before FMP quote/news so empty symbol lists stop cleanly.
- Added Gemini bypass gate for no-LLM-candidate runs.
- Fixed Gemini JSON body to send an object, not a string.
- Wired Google Sheets nodes to the created tracker spreadsheet.
